summary: Biodexa Pharmaceuticals PLC filed a Form 6-K disclosing a September 14, 2026 warrant inducement agreement with one accredited holder of Series M, N and O warrants issued July 1, 2026. The exercise price was cut to $1.05 per share, and the holder exercised all existing warrants (282,952 Series M; 701,754 Series N; 1,219,512 Series O), yielding 2,204,218 ADSs, each ADS equal to 50 ordinary shares. Gross proceeds are about $2.3 million before Maxim Group's 8.0% cash fee; closing expected on or about September 15, 2026. Two Series P warrants per existing warrant were issued, immediately exercisable with a five-year term, carrying anti-dilution protection but no price protection, with resale registration required within 15 days and effectiveness within 45 days. Watch registration timing, liquidated damages risk, and any resulting holder overhang.
